podcasts.title: Ep. 042 - GDPx: The Benchmark for Frontier AI
podcasts.description:
SemiAnalysis just launched GDPx, a benchmark built with 14 specialized data partners across 11 domains where frontier intelligence earns the highest returns. Even the best model scores just 12%.

podcasts.title: Dynamic Allocation and Concentrated Conviction – Zack McGuire (EP.524)
podcasts.description:
Zack McGuire is Senior Managing Director of Investments at Children's Healthcare of Atlanta.
 
Zack's career spans Citigroup, Emory University, the University of Georgia Foundation, and the Maine Public Employees Retirement System before joining Children's three and a half years ago.
 
His responsibilities extend well beyond investing into team leadership, overseeing the investment process, and strategic initiatives across the broader healthcare system.
 
Our conversation covers how an institution's capital base shapes its investment strategy, CHOA's thematic approach to portfolio construction, empowering a team of generalists, and leveraging investment relationships to support the broader institution.
 
Zack brings humility, curiosity, and conviction to his work, grounded in a belief that resonates deeply with us at Capital Allocators: one of the best ways to compound capital is to compound relationships.

podcasts.title: How a 19-year-old intern built the growth engine behind this $2B AI company | Hector Serrano
podcasts.description:
Hector Serrano runs one of the most innovative and successful paid growth programs in Silicon Valley. As Head of Content at Wispr Flow, a leading AI voice-to-text tool, he built a roster of 50 creators who drive 500 to 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads every month. The creators are paid a cut of ad spend, and the best of them earn over $13,000 a month. It’s a playbook the best DTC brands have used for years, now adapted for SaaS. Hector joined Wispr Flow at 19, before the product had PMF, and over the past year, Wispr Flow has grown revenue 30x and raised at a $2 billion valuation.

We discuss:

1. Why paid UGC is one of the biggest untapped growth levers right now
